plan: Archie has awakened Kyogre: the Blue Orb reverts it to Primal form and Origin Pulse hits both foes under endless rain, Hydration Goodra Thunders, Rain Dish Tentacruel Icy Winds, Swift Swim Poliwrath Close Combats, Speed Boost Sharpedo snowballs, and Mega Eelektross's Levitate Wild Charge finishes.
crack: Fire is useless under Primordial Sea, so Electric and Grass are the answers: Electric hits Kyogre, Tentacruel, Poliwrath and Sharpedo, Grass hits Kyogre and Poliwrath, Ice and Fairy hit Goodra, Ground blanks nothing here because Eelektross Levitates, so bring Grass for it.

plan: Andrea opens the deep with the answer to every safety net: Skill Link Cloyster fires five Icicle Spears through Sturdy and Sashes alike, Choice Band Floatzel outruns most of what is left, and Jellicent absorbs the Water you meant for either.
crack: Cloyster is frail before it Shell Smashes and Jellicent cannot touch a Dark type; Electric and Grass answer this whole room twice over.

plan: Crissy sings through cover: Liquid Voice Primarina turns Hyper Voice into a Water move that ignores Substitutes and hits both of you, Emergency Exit Golisopod leads with First Impression and leaves, and Schooling Wishiwashi becomes a wall the moment it takes the field. Coordination review: The opening attack no longer damages Swanna. Self-set rain powers safe Water pressure. Liquid Voice already supplies safe spread damage; Hydro Pump adds focused pressure.
crack: Wishiwashi drops back to a minnow below a quarter health, Golisopod flees the moment you chip it, and Electric and Grass still answer the room.

plan: Brianna never shows you the same type twice: Protean Greninja becomes whatever it is about to use, Sniper Inteleon crits for more than it should, Propeller Tail Barraskewda ignores every redirection you own, and Unaware Quagsire ignores every boost you have made. Coordination review: Water pressure no longer hits the Unaware partner. The other half of the opening also gains safe coverage.
crack: Protean only changes type after it commits, so predict the move and the type is yours to punish; Quagsire has no offence, and Grass answers five of the six.

plan: Connie makes your attacks go somewhere else: Storm Drain Gastrodon and Lumineon swallow every Water move on the field, Lightning Rod Seaking takes the Electric you brought to answer them, and Huntail Shell Smashes behind all of it.
crack: Redirection does nothing against spread moves or against Grass, which hits four of the six; Huntail is helpless the turn before it sets up.

plan: Bridget brings the rain the gym has been hinting at: Pelipper's Drizzle turns on Swift Swim for Omastar, Kabutops and Ludicolo at once, and Mega Swampert gains Swift Swim of its own the moment it evolves. Coordination review: The rain setter no longer damages its Shell Smash partner. Physical Ground coverage avoids the grounded rain attackers. Swift Swim coverage stays usable beside all partners.
crack: Change the weather and four of the six lose half their speed; Grass hits almost everyone, and Pelipper itself folds to a single Electric move.

plan: Olivia wants to be hit: Solid Rock Carracosta and a Weakness Policy turn your best move into her setup, Water Bubble Araquanid doubles its own Water damage and halves your Fire, and Mega Blastoise fires Mega Launcher pulses at everything. Coordination review: Water spread pressure no longer damages the team's setup pieces.
crack: Weakness Policy needs a super effective hit, so neutral damage or status starves it; Grass and Electric answer the room, and Relicanth is slow enough to remove first.

plan: Tiffany heals off what you send: Water Absorb Vaporeon and Seismitoad gain health from every Water move, Wish keeps the rest alive, and Sheer Force Feraligatr Dragon Dances once and stops being answerable. Coordination review: Safe Ground coverage complements the retained Surf/Water Absorb opening.
crack: Nothing here absorbs Grass or Electric, Barbaracle is frail before its Smash, and Walrein is slow enough to be removed before it settles.

plan: Bethany hits far above her weight: Huge Power Azumarill Belly Drums and then Aqua Jets, Zero to Hero Palafin comes back from a switch as something else entirely, and Mega Sharpedo gains a speed stage every turn it stays out.
crack: Belly Drum leaves Azumarill at a quarter health, Palafin is ordinary until it has switched once, and Sharpedo has no bulk at all -- anything faster ends it.

plan: Annika turns your status against you: Cloud Nine Golduck switches off the weather entirely, Marvel Scale Milotic gains half its Defence again from its own burn, Competitive Empoleon doubles its Special Attack when you lower a stat, and Hisuian Samurott's Sharpness cuts through what survives. Coordination review: Focused Water damage avoids friendly fire. Defensive Water spread pressure becomes partner-safe. Support no longer erases Golduck or Quaquaval's boosts.
crack: Do not burn or debuff anything and half her team is ordinary; Electric and Grass still answer the room, and Pyukumuku cannot attack at all.

plan: Lapras supports selected Surf lines through Water Absorb while Samurott applies physical pressure. Rotom pivots without relying on burns under Misty Terrain. Dragalge uses partner-safe Poison and Water attacks, Basculegion supplies Specs pressure, and Assault Vest Tapu Fini protects the field while attacking.
crack: Misty Terrain protects only what stands on the ground, and Tapu Fini is passive until it has set up; Grass and Electric answer most of the room, and Dragalge is desperately slow.

plan: Politoed opens eight-turn rain while Suicune offers Tailwind and Snarl. Partner-safe Water attacks replace the repeated friendly-fire Surf casts. Toxapex applies Acid Spray to open special targets instead of erasing Manaphy and Gyarados boosts with Haze. Tail Glow Manaphy and Swift Swim Kingdra exploit the rain, and Mega Gyarados can Protect while choosing its Dragon Dance turn.
crack: Change weather or stall its finite duration to weaken the rain engine. Disrupt Tailwind, pressure Politoed, and use Electric or Grass attacks with care around Ice coverage. Steel blocks Toxapex's Poison plan, while physical pressure bypasses Snarl.

plan: Joshua's Magic Guard Alakazam Encores, Screen Cleaner Mr. Rime Freeze-Dries, and Choice Scarf Darmanitan Flare Blitzes. The reserves extend that opening: Starmie supplies Hydro Pump.

plan: Intimidate Incineroar creates room for Yveltal's Tailwind with Fake Out and Parting Shot. Dark Aura strengthens the Dark attacks across the team; Snarl reduces special pressure. Darkrai disrupts, Urshifu and Hoopa break protection, and Mega Absol Z closes with priority.

plan: Giratina opens with burns and Icy Wind beside Shadow Shield Lunala's Calm Mind. Marshadow steals opposing boosts and Shedinja forces precise coverage. Burn support also gives Specs Spectrier a stronger Hex option, while Mega Gengar remains the trapping finisher. The team uses attrition and speed reduction rather than another Tailwind opening.
crack: Disrupt Lunala's setup, protect against burns or stat drops, and bring reliable Ghost or Dark coverage. Indirect damage answers Shedinja, while careful positioning matters before Shadow Tag appears.

plan: Alolan Ninetales opens Aurora Veil beside Specs Kyurem's accurate Blizzard. Articuno supplies Tailwind and can restore snow when needed. Chien-Pao amplifies the physical Ice attackers; Glastrier trades powerful hits and Mega Baxcalibur is the reserved closer. Snow and Veil have finite durations.

crack: Ice hits every one of them and quadruples on Salamence and Garchomp, Fairy hits all six and quadruples on none, Ground hits Reshiram and Zekrom, Flying and Psychic hit Koraidon, Regidrago fades as it takes damage, and Koraidon's own sun weakens the Water that would answer Reshiram.

Palkia supplies special coverage, Milotic can strengthen its partner with Helping Hand, and Mega Starmie closes at high speed. The team no longer asks Milotic to sleep grounded targets under its own terrain.
crack: Contest weather or terrain, pressure Kyogre before Water Spout, and use Grass or Electric offense with respect for coverage. Physical pressure bypasses Competitive; speed control and careful targeting can break the supporting pair.
